CustomField.formula: IF( TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))< 0, "(", "") & "$" & IF(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))) / 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))))), 3) & "." & IF(MOD(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))) , 1) * 100 < 10, "0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))) , 1), 2) * 100), TEXT(MIN(ROUND(MOD(ABS(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))) , 1), 2) * 100, 99))) & IF(TotalDays__c * VALUE(TEXT(PerDiemAllowanceRate__c))< 0, ")", "")
CustomField.label: Per Diem Allowance Total
